title: 第 二百零三章
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

老人说了很多话，周复之静静听着，时不时开口，象征身份的白大褂穿在他身上，鼻梁上夹着副无度数镜框，看起来温和又靠谱，一派沉稳。

送走老人，周复之冲着跟自己打招呼的护士点点头，抬脚进了自己的办公室。

一走进去周复之就看到了鸠占鹊巢的祝予盘着腿坐在他椅子上。

自持稳重的周医生眼睛一亮：“小水！东西带来了吗？”

祝予弯腰把来医院之前买的东西提溜上来。

“放心，特意说了没放洋葱。”

周复之哞的一声就扑了上来：“烤冷面我的烤冷面，想死我了。”

这附近没有摆摊的，虽然可以叫外卖，但周复之还是馋这种小摊上卖的，吃着最有感觉。

得知祝予要来，周复之抽空给她发了条消息，她便专门绕了一圈去地铁口附近给他买的。

“来口不？”

祝予摇头，她晚饭吃的足够多，一点也不饿。

看着周复之风卷残云的吃完大份烤冷面，又狼吞虎咽的把祝予从家里带来的饭吃干净，一看就是饿狠了。

祝予抽了张纸递给他：“今天很忙吗？”

周复之说今天做手术的患者体重三百斤，祝予只听这一句便肃然起敬。

他中午就对付了几口，现在是真饿惨了。

“听说余疏那小子今天去找你了，现在回去了？”

提起余疏，周复之还撇了撇嘴。

祝予说他回海市了，周复之才哼唧了两声勉强满意。

紧接着又念叨着：“你不许早恋。”

祝予拔着草莓肛毛：“你不也早恋。”

周复之说那不一样，他们那叫天作之合属于不可抗力。

眼见祝予还要说，周复之终于发觉不对劲了额，他放下筷子，狐疑的盯着她看了两秒：“我上次说你还没反应。”

祝予迟疑了两秒，最终还是选择坦荡把话说出来：“因为我已经早恋了。”

下一秒，原本好好坐着的周复之像是被抽了骨头一样软倒在地上，不省人事。

祝予咬了口草莓尖尖，满脸习惯：“你再不醒我就要踩你脸了哦。”

那不行，保养费很贵诶！

周复之立马睁开眼，满脸痛心疾首的看向她：“怎么能是余疏呢，你看上那小子什么了！？”

Page (1/3)

The old man spoke a lot, and Zhou Fuzhi listened quietly and spoke from time to time. He wore a white coat that symbolized his status, and a pair of glasses with no prescription on the bridge of his nose. He looked gentle, reliable, and calm.

After seeing the old man off, Zhou Fuzhi nodded to the nurse who greeted him and walked into his office.

As soon as Zhou Fuzhi walked in, he saw Zhu Yu sitting cross-legged on his chair.

The self-possessed Doctor Zhou's eyes lit up: "Xiao Shui! Have you brought the things?"

Zhu Yu bent down and picked up the things he bought before coming to the hospital.

"Don't worry, I specifically said no onions."

Zhou Fuzhi rushed forward with a moo: "Roasted cold noodles, my roasted cold noodles, you miss me so much."

There are no stalls nearby. Although you can order takeout, Zhou Fuzhi is still greedy for the food sold at such small stalls. It is the most enjoyable to eat.

Knowing that Zhu Yu was coming, Zhou Fuzhi took the time to send her a message, and she made a special trip to buy it for him near the subway entrance.

"Would you like to speak?"

Zhu Yu shook her head. She had eaten enough for dinner and was not hungry at all.

Watching Zhou Fuzhi finish a large portion of grilled cold noodles in a hurry, and then wolf down the meal Zhu Yu brought from home, he was very hungry at first sight.

Zhu Yu took out a piece of paper and handed it to him: "Are you busy today?"

Zhou Fuzhi said that the patient undergoing surgery today weighed three hundred pounds. Zhu Yu was in awe after hearing this sentence.

He had eaten a few bites at noon, and now he was really hungry.

"I heard that boy Yu Shu went to see you today. Is he going back now?"

Zhou Fuzhi curled his lips when he mentioned Yu Shu.

Zhu Yu said that he had returned to Haishi, and Zhou Fuzhi grunted twice and was reluctantly satisfied.

Then he muttered: "You are not allowed to fall in love prematurely."

Zhu Yu plucked Strawberry's anal hair and said, "Don't you also fall in love early?"

Zhou Fuzhi said that was different, that their match was made in heaven and was force majeure.

Seeing that Zhu Yu wanted to talk, Zhou Fuzhi finally realized that something was wrong. He put down his chopsticks and stared at her suspiciously for two seconds: "I said last time that you didn't respond."

Zhu Yu hesitated for two seconds, and finally chose to speak frankly: "Because I have fallen in love early."

The next second, Zhou Fuzhi, who was sitting peacefully, fell to the ground as if his bones had been knocked out, unconscious.

Zhu Yu took a bite of the tip of the strawberry and said with a habitual look on her face: "If you don't wake up, I will step on your face."

That won't work, the maintenance fee is very expensive!

Zhou Fuzhi immediately opened his eyes and looked at her with a heartbroken expression: "How could it be Yu Shu? What did you see in that kid!?"
